digest.note: one message (blotter de las 08:00, audit 2026-09-12): F1–F7 stay in agent.json and on the currency page; marks = ⧗ otro reloj, LAG por cadencia (daily 3 d / weekly 10 d / monthly 25 d), cobertura parcial, proxy

regime_change_general.note: regime.json regimes.general.regime changes vs last notified

regime_change_block.note: central_bank or fiscal confirmed regime changes vs last notified

gate_withheld.note: daily_log inventory A1–A5 pass -> fail (and recovery fail -> pass); worded 'inventario', never 'puerta' (the price gate is another thing)

block_degraded.note: only unavailable/degraded transitions fire; stale/proxy flap between lanes and go to the digest

refresh_error.note: source errors by source name, once per 24 h, one sanitized line (no HTML); recovery only when the error was sent and the same lane later runs clean

jefe_ranking_change.note: new jefe Friday: own position changed, or top/bottom currency changed

price_gate.note: FLOOR_FRICTION / LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY entered or left (covered by regime_change_general, listed for clarity)

suppression.note: an event fires once, on the transition; the same state on later refreshes is silent; the first run of a currency (no notify_state.json) is silent too. State persisted in data/<ccy>/notify_state.json (errors_sent by source name)

format.numbers: only from agent.json / regime.json / jefe.json (no computation in the notifier)
